extra.final_summary:
Found and fixed several data quality issues:
1. Island column had label variants ("Dream " with trailing space, "torgersen" lowercase) - normalized to "Dream" and "Torgersen"
2. body_mass_g was stored as text with comma separators (e.g., "3,150") - converted to numeric
3. flipper_length_mm had 3 rows with negative values (-215, -228, -198) outside valid range [170, 235] - excluded rows 46, 47, 63
4. body_mass_g had 1 row with invalid value 3550000 (outside range [2500, 6500]) - excluded row 14

After cleaning, analyzed 60 rows to get total body mass by species:
- Adelie: 117,250 g
- Chinstrap: 55,625 g
- Gentoo: 70,175 g
